examples.english: The disease has accentuated. His Majesty is withering away before our eyes.
examples.text: La enfermedad se ha acentuado. Su Majestad decae a ojos vistas.
examples.translation: The disease has accentuated. His Majesty is withering away before our eyes.

examples.english: But the modern age tends, before our eyes, to scorn the peaceful work of the intellect.
examples.text: Mas la época actual tiende, a ojos vistas, a despreciar la obra pacífica de la inteligencia.
examples.translation: But the modern age tends, before our eyes, to scorn the peaceful work of the intellect.

examples.english: "For you, ma'am", he managed to say, all confused, until he visibly ruined the compliment he had prepared.
examples.ref: 1926, Leopoldo Lugones, “chapter XXIX”, in El Angel de la Sombra:
examples.text: —Para la señorita —acertó a decir, confuso, hasta malograr a ojos vistas el cumplimiento que traía preparado.
examples.translation: "For you, ma'am", he managed to say, all confused, until he visibly ruined the compliment he had prepared.
